design.body: 大头、紧凑躯干、短四肢、宽脚掌
design.hands: 双臂均为双指机械夹爪
design.palette: 白色、藏蓝、灰青腹甲、琥珀色指示灯

skills.name: 夹臂横扫
phases: 压低重心、单臂后拉蓄力
转体带动夹臂向前横扫
前脚承重、夹爪接触点闪光
手臂落下、身体前倾收招
skills.readability: 单臂、原地近身弧线攻击；蓄力和收招轮廓明显

skills.name: 突进夹击
phases: 屈膝蹬地准备、双钳张开
身体前倾、短距离地面突进
前脚踩实、双钳向内夹合
skills.readability: 双臂、直线位移攻击；刹停后有反击窗口

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production ANIMATION KEY POSE SHEET for OMI-01, a robot enemy in a 2.5D side-scrolling action game. Reference image is a STRICT locked character design. Draw ONLY the ROBOT from reference; omit the human entirely. Preserve EXACTLY the approved short compact large spherical head, single amber ring on black faceplate, white helmet, white chest/limb shells, navy shoulder caps/toe caps, muted teal belly, black joints, amber circular joint lights, BOTH arms end in identical two-pronged blunt mechanical grippers. Keep short legs and large stable feet; same head size, limb lengths and body mass every pose. Robot looks like the reference, not a generic Transformer, no redesign, no new weapons, no wings, no extra limbs. Clean rounded premium 3D animated-game concept art with believable mechanical articulations. Make poses substantially different and anatomically functional, feet firmly grounded except intentional step. All panels true orthographic SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT with just enough small torso twist to distinguish far arm, fixed camera and identical character scale. Plain very light blue-gray background, subtle thin ground line in each panel, soft studio shading. Landscape 3:2, 2x2 orderly large panels with generous spacing, entire body visible in each, no overlaps between panels. Title 'OMI-01' top left. Legible minimal English labels only as specified. Motion arcs subtle amber graphic cues, never giant glowing energy blades, do not obscure silhouette. Sheet title 'CLAMP SWEEP'. Four key poses sequence: panel1 WINDUP: feet planted wide, knees bend, torso leans and twists back LEFT, camera-near arm elbow bent drawing open gripper back behind waist; far arm balances forward low; amber eye ring slightly brighter. panel2 SWING: grounded weight shift to forward right foot, torso rotates forward, near arm makes compact chest-height forward sweeping strike, open gripper travels left-to-right; a SHORT curved amber line traces hand path only. panel3 IMPACT: near arm extended FORWARD RIGHT at torso level but elbow not locked, gripper snaps partially shut with small orange contact sparks in empty air at tip, rear foot heel lifted, far arm pulled back for counterbalance; no target character. panel4 RECOVER: overextended torso tipped a little forward, attacking arm lowered, knees absorb weight, head remains looking right, visible recovery opening before returning idle. All four full bodies SAME SIZE; emphasize readable windup and recovery.
